math_steps.title: 逐档累计费用，建立分段函数

math_steps.explanation:
$$y=\begin{cases}0.6x,&0\le x\le 180\\0.65x-9,&180<x\le 350\\0.9x-96.5,&x>350\end{cases}$$

$$\begin{gathered}\frac{3 x}{5}=199\\x=\frac{995}{3}\\x\in \left\{\frac{995}{3}\right\}\end{gathered}$$

$$\begin{gathered}\frac{995}{3}\notin\left[0, 180\right]\quad\text{舍去}\\\left\{\frac{995}{3}\right\}\cap \left[0, 180\right]=\emptyset\end{gathered}$$

$$\begin{gathered}\frac{13 x}{20} - 9=199\\\frac{13 x}{20}=208\\x=320\\x\in \left\{320\right\}\end{gathered}$$

$$\begin{gathered}320\in\left(180, 350\right]\quad\text{保留}\\\left\{320\right\}\cap \left(180, 350\right]=\left\{320\right\}\end{gathered}$$

$$\begin{gathered}\frac{9 x}{10} - \frac{193}{2}=199\\\frac{9 x}{10}=\frac{591}{2}\\x=\frac{985}{3}\\x\in \left\{\frac{985}{3}\right\}\end{gathered}$$

$$\begin{gathered}\frac{985}{3}\notin\left(350, \infty\right)\quad\text{舍去}\\\left\{\frac{985}{3}\right\}\cap \left(350, \infty\right)=\emptyset\end{gathered}$$
